title: wg: combiner-02 L285 'Consistent' membership is never defined
description:
draft-ietf-mls-combiner (combiner-02), 3.1.1 Welcome Message Validation / 3.2 Removing a Group Member. Editors' copy mlswg/mls-combiner at 380f0e1, L285.

Text: "All members MUST verify group membership is consistent in both sessions after"

Problem: 'Consistent' membership is never defined. The two sessions have different leaf indices and signature keys, and in mode 1 different credential types. The draft also gives no action when the check fails. Line 326 repeats the same untestable MUST.

Suggested fix: Define the mapping (for example, each member's T and PQ credentials present the same application identity, and the identity sets are equal). State that a Commit pair or Welcome that fails the check MUST be rejected.

Severity: high. Verifier: keep (Confirmed at lines 285-286 and 326-327. The draft defines no cross-session member mapping or failure action anywhere. No issue covers this.)

From MLS audit workflow wf_581e61f8-b25 (2026-10-21). Not yet reviewed by Mark; nothing posted upstream.
